es.name: Destructor
es.description: Golpea con las patas o la cola.

en.name: Pound
en.description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

es.name: Golpe Kárate
es.description: Da un golpe cortante. Suele ser crítico.

en.name: Karate Chop
en.description: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Doble Bofetón
es.description: Abofetea de dos a cinco veces seguidas.

en.name: Double Slap
en.description: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

es.name: Puño Cometa
es.description: Pega de dos a cinco veces seguidas.

en.name: Comet Punch
en.description: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

es.name: Megapuño
es.description: Un puñetazo de gran potencia.

en.name: Mega Punch
en.description: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

es.name: Día de Pago
es.description: Arroja monedas al objetivo. Las recupera al final del combate.

en.name: Pay Day
en.description: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.

es.name: Puño Fuego
es.description: Puñetazo ardiente. Puede quemar.

en.name: Fire Punch
en.description: The target is punched with a fiery fist. This may also leave the target with a burn.

es.name: Puño Hielo
es.description: Puñetazo helado. Puede congelar.

en.name: Ice Punch
en.description: The target is punched with an icy fist. This may also leave the target frozen.

es.name: Puño Trueno
es.description: Puñetazo eléctrico. Puede paralizar.

en.name: Thunder Punch
en.description: The target is punched with an electrified fist. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Arañazo
es.description: Araña con afiladas garras.

en.name: Scratch
en.description: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

es.name: Agarre
es.description: Atrapa y atenaza al objetivo.

en.name: Vise Grip
en.description: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

es.name: Guillotina
es.description: Ataque con pinzas que debilita al oponente de un golpe si acierta.

en.name: Guillotine
en.description: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

es.name: Viento Cortante
es.description: Primero se prepara y en el segundo turno ataca al oponente con ráfagas de viento cortante. Alta probabilidad de ser crítico.

en.name: Razor Wind
en.description: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Danza Espada
es.description: Baile frenético que aumenta mucho el Ataque.

en.name: Swords Dance
en.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

es.name: Corte
es.description: Corta con garras, guadañas, etc. También sirve para cortar árboles finos.

en.name: Cut
en.description: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. This can also be used to cut down thin trees.

es.name: Tornado
es.description: Crea un tornado con las alas y lo lanza contra el objetivo.

en.name: Gust
en.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

es.name: Ataque Ala
es.description: Golpea al objetivo con unas grandes alas.

en.name: Wing Attack
en.description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

es.name: Remolino
es.description: Se lleva al objetivo, que es cambiado por otro Pokémon. Si es un Pokémon salvaje, acaba el combate.

en.name: Whirlwind
en.description: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

es.name: Vuelo
es.description: Primer turno: vuela. Segundo turno: ataca. Fuera de combate, permite ir a sitios ya conocidos.

en.name: Fly
en.description: The user soars and then strikes its target on the next turn. This can also be used to fly to any familiar town.

es.name: Atadura
es.description: Ata y oprime de cuatro a cinco turnos.

en.name: Bind
en.description: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

es.name: Atizar
es.description: Golpea con las extremidades.

en.name: Slam
en.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

es.name: Látigo Cepa
es.description: Azota al objetivo con ramas finas.

en.name: Vine Whip
en.description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

es.name: Pisotón
es.description: Tremendo pisotón que puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Stomp
en.description: The target is stomped with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Doble Patada
es.description: Una patada doble. Golpea dos veces.

en.name: Double Kick
en.description: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

es.name: Megapatada
es.description: Patada de extrema fuerza.

en.name: Mega Kick
en.description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

es.name: Patada Salto
es.description: Da un salto y pega una patada. Si falla, se lesiona.

en.name: Jump Kick
en.description: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.

es.name: Patada Giro
es.description: Da una patada rápida y circular. Puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Rolling Kick
en.description: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Ataque Arena
es.description: Arroja arena a la cara y baja la Precisión.

en.name: Sand Attack
en.description: Sand is hurled in the target’s face, reducing the target’s accuracy.

es.name: Golpe Cabeza
es.description: Lanza un potente cabezazo que puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Headbutt
en.description: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Cornada
es.description: Ataca al objetivo con una cornada.

en.name: Horn Attack
en.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

es.name: Ataque Furia
es.description: Cornea al objetivo de dos a cinco veces.

en.name: Fury Attack
en.description: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

es.name: Perforador
es.description: Ataque con taladro que fulmina en un golpe al objetivo si le toca.

en.name: Horn Drill
en.description: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

es.name: Placaje
es.description: Embiste con todo el cuerpo.

en.name: Tackle
en.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

es.name: Golpe Cuerpo
es.description: Salta sobre el objetivo con todo su peso. Puede paralizar.

en.name: Body Slam
en.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Constricción
es.description: Oprime al objetivo de cuatro a cinco turnos con ramas o con su cuerpo.

en.name: Wrap
en.description: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

es.name: Derribo
es.description: Carga desmedida que también hiere al agresor.

en.name: Take Down
en.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

es.name: Saña
es.description: Ataca de dos a tres turnos y acaba confundiendo al agresor.

en.name: Thrash
en.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

es.name: Doble Filo
es.description: Ataque arriesgado que también hiere al agresor.

en.name: Double-Edge
en.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle. This also damages the user quite a lot.

es.name: Agitacola
es.description: Agita la cola para bajar la Defensa del equipo rival.

en.name: Tail Whip
en.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.

es.name: Picotazo Veneno
es.description: Lanza un aguijón tóxico que puede envenenar al objetivo.

en.name: Poison Sting
en.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

es.name: Doble Ataque
es.description: Pincha dos veces con dos espinas. Puede envenenar.

en.name: Twineedle
en.description: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. This may also poison the target.

es.name: Pin Misil
es.description: Lanza finas púas que hieren de dos a cinco veces.

en.name: Pin Missile
en.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

es.name: Malicioso
es.description: Intimida a los rivales para bajar su Defensa.

en.name: Leer
en.description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers the Defense stat.

es.name: Mordisco
es.description: Un voraz bocado que puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Bite
en.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Gruñido
es.description: Dulce gruñido que reduce el Ataque del contrincante.

en.name: Growl
en.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

es.name: Rugido
es.description: Se lleva al objetivo, que es cambiado por otro Pokémon. Si es un Pokémon salvaje, acaba el combate.

en.name: Roar
en.description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

es.name: Canto
es.description: Cancioncilla que hace dormir profundamente al objetivo.

en.name: Sing
en.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

es.name: Supersónico
es.description: Raras ondas sónicas que confunden al objetivo.

en.name: Supersonic
en.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

es.name: Bomba Sónica
es.description: Lanza ondas de choque que restan 20 PS al objetivo.

en.name: Sonic Boom
en.description: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

es.name: Anulación
es.description: Desactiva el último movimiento del objetivo durante cuatro turnos.

en.name: Disable
en.description: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

es.name: Ácido
es.description: Rocía a los enemigos con un ácido corrosivo. Puede bajar la Defensa Especial.

en.name: Acid
en.description: The opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.

es.name: Ascuas
es.description: Ataca con llamas pequeñas que pueden causar quemaduras.

en.name: Ember
en.description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

es.name: Lanzallamas
es.description: Ataca con una gran ráfaga de fuego que puede causar quemaduras.

en.name: Flamethrower
en.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

es.name: Neblina
es.description: Rodea de fina niebla al usuario y protege las características de su equipo durante cinco turnos.

en.name: Mist
en.description: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

es.name: Pistola Agua
es.description: Ataca disparando agua con gran potencia.

en.name: Water Gun
en.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

es.name: Hidrobomba
es.description: Lanza una gran masa de agua a presión para atacar.

en.name: Hydro Pump
en.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

es.name: Surf
es.description: Inunda el campo de batalla con una ola gigante. Fuera de batalla sirve para moverse sobre el agua.

en.name: Surf
en.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave. This can also be used for crossing water.

es.name: Rayo Hielo
es.description: Rayo de hielo que puede llegar a congelar.

en.name: Ice Beam
en.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

es.name: Ventisca
es.description: Tormenta de hielo que puede llegar a congelar.

en.name: Blizzard
en.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

es.name: Psicorrayo
es.description: Extraño rayo que puede causar confusión.

en.name: Psybeam
en.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also leave the target confused.

es.name: Rayo Burbuja
es.description: Diluvio de burbujas que puede bajar la Velocidad.

en.name: Bubble Beam
en.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower its Speed stat.

es.name: Rayo Aurora
es.description: Rayo multicolor que puede reducir el Ataque.

en.name: Aurora Beam
en.description: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

es.name: Hiperrayo
es.description: Es eficaz, pero el atacante deberá descansar en el siguiente turno.

en.name: Hyper Beam
en.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

es.name: Picotazo
es.description: Ensarta al objetivo con un cuerno o pico punzante.

en.name: Peck
en.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

es.name: Pico Taladro
es.description: Picotazo giratorio y perforador muy potente.

en.name: Drill Peck
en.description: A corkscrewing attack with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

es.name: Sumisión
es.description: Tira al objetivo al suelo. También hiere al agresor.

en.name: Submission
en.description: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.

es.name: Patada Baja
es.description: Patada baja. Cuanto más pesa el objetivo, más daño causa.

en.name: Low Kick
en.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

es.name: Contraataque
es.description: Devuelve un golpe físico por duplicado.

en.name: Counter
en.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

es.name: Sísmico
es.description: La gravedad derriba al objetivo. Se restarán tantos PS como nivel tenga el agresor.

en.name: Seismic Toss
en.description: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

es.name: Fuerza
es.description: Potente puñetazo. Fuera de combate sirve para mover rocas.

en.name: Strength
en.description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. This can also be used to move heavy boulders.

es.name: Absorber
es.description: Absorbe la mitad del daño producido en el objetivo para restaurar los PS del usuario.

en.name: Absorb
en.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

es.name: Megaagotar
es.description: Absorbe la mitad del daño producido en el objetivo para restaurar los PS del usuario.

en.name: Mega Drain
en.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

es.name: Drenadoras
es.description: Planta semillas que absorben PS para recuperar la salud del usuario en cada turno.

en.name: Leech Seed
en.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

es.name: Desarrollo
es.description: El cuerpo del usuario crece a marchas forzadas y aumenta el Ataque y el Ataque Especial.

en.name: Growth
en.description: The user’s body grows all at once, raising the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

es.name: Hoja Afilada
es.description: Corta con hojas afiladas. Suele ser crítico.

en.name: Razor Leaf
en.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the opposing Pokémon. Critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Rayo Solar
es.description: Primer turno: absorbe luz. Segundo turno: lanza un potente rayo de energía.

en.name: Solar Beam
en.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

es.name: Polvo Veneno
es.description: Polvo tóxico que envenena al objetivo.

en.name: Poison Powder
en.description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. This may also poison the target.

es.name: Paralizador
es.description: Esparce polvo que paraliza al objetivo.

en.name: Stun Spore
en.description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

es.name: Somnífero
es.description: Esparce polvo que duerme al objetivo.

en.name: Sleep Powder
en.description: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target.

es.name: Danza Pétalo
es.description: Lanza pétalos de dos a tres turnos y acaba confundiendo al atacante.

en.name: Petal Dance
en.description: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

es.name: Disparo Demora
es.description: Lanza seda a los rivales y reduce mucho su Velocidad.

en.name: String Shot
en.description: The opposing Pokémon are bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth that harshly lowers the Speed stat.

es.name: Furia Dragón
es.description: Ráfaga de furiosas ondas de choque que quitan 40 PS.

en.name: Dragon Rage
en.description: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

es.name: Giro Fuego
es.description: Un aro de fuego que atrapa al objetivo de cuatro a cinco turnos.

en.name: Fire Spin
en.description: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

es.name: Impactrueno
es.description: Ataque eléctrico que puede paralizar al objetivo.

en.name: Thunder Shock
en.description: A jolt of electricity crashes down on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Rayo
es.description: Potente ataque eléctrico que puede paralizar al objetivo.

en.name: Thunderbolt
en.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Onda Trueno
es.description: Una ligera descarga que paraliza al objetivo si lo alcanza.

en.name: Thunder Wave
en.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

es.name: Trueno
es.description: Un poderoso rayo que daña al objetivo y puede paralizarlo.

en.name: Thunder
en.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Lanzarrocas
es.description: Tira una pequeña roca al objetivo.

en.name: Rock Throw
en.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

es.name: Terremoto
es.description: Un terremoto que afecta a los Pokémon de alrededor en combate.

en.name: Earthquake
en.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

es.name: Fisura
es.description: Abre una grieta en el suelo y mete al objetivo en ella. Fulmina en un golpe.

en.name: Fissure
en.description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

es.name: Excavar
es.description: Primer turno: cava. Segundo turno: ataca. También sirve para salir de ciertas zonas.

en.name: Dig
en.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the next turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

es.name: Tóxico
es.description: Envenena gravemente al objetivo y causa un daño mayor en cada turno.

en.name: Toxic
en.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

es.name: Confusión
es.description: Débil ataque telequinético que puede causar confusión.

en.name: Confusion
en.description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. This may also confuse the target.

es.name: Psíquico
es.description: Fuerte ataque telequinético que puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.

en.name: Psychic
en.description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

es.name: Hipnosis
es.description: Ataque hipnótico que hace dormir profundamente al objetivo.

en.name: Hypnosis
en.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

es.name: Meditación
es.description: El usuario reposa y medita para potenciar el Ataque.

en.name: Meditate
en.description: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

es.name: Agilidad
es.description: Relaja el cuerpo para ganar mucha Velocidad.

en.name: Agility
en.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

es.name: Ataque Rápido
es.description: Ataque rápido que permite golpear en primer lugar.

en.name: Quick Attack
en.description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This move always goes first.

es.name: Furia
es.description: Al usarse, aumenta el Ataque del usuario cada vez que es golpeado.

en.name: Rage
en.description: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage raises the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.

es.name: Teletransporte
es.description: Permite huir al instante de combates contra Pokémon salvajes o viajar al último Centro Pokémon visitado.

en.name: Teleport
en.description: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It can also warp to the last Pokémon Center visited.

es.name: Tinieblas
es.description: Produce un espejismo ante el objetivo, que pierde tantos PS como nivel tenga el agresor.

en.name: Night Shade
en.description: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

es.name: Mimético
es.description: Copia el último movimiento usado por el objetivo. Dicho movimiento se podrá usar mientras el Pokémon no sea cambiado.

en.name: Mimic
en.description: The user copies the target’s last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.

es.name: Chirrido
es.description: Alarido agudo que reduce mucho la Defensa del objetivo.

en.name: Screech
en.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

es.name: Doble Equipo
es.description: Crea copias de sí mismo para mejorar la Evasión.

en.name: Double Team
en.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

es.name: Recuperación
es.description: Restaura hasta la mitad de los PS máximos.

en.name: Recover
en.description: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

es.name: Fortaleza
es.description: Tensa la musculatura del usuario para aumentar la Defensa.

en.name: Harden
en.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

es.name: Reducción
es.description: El usuario mengua para aumentar mucho la Evasión.

en.name: Minimize
en.description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

es.name: Pantalla de Humo
es.description: Baja la Precisión del objetivo con una nube de humo o tinta.

en.name: Smokescreen
en.description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

es.name: Rayo Confuso
es.description: Rayo siniestro que confunde al objetivo.

en.name: Confuse Ray
en.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

es.name: Refugio
es.description: El usuario se protege en su coraza y sube la Defensa.

en.name: Withdraw
en.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

es.name: Rizo Defensa
es.description: Se enrosca para ocultar su punto débil. Sube la Defensa.

en.name: Defense Curl
en.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

es.name: Barrera
es.description: Crea una barrera que aumenta mucho la Defensa.

en.name: Barrier
en.description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

es.name: Pantalla de Luz
es.description: Pared de luz que reduce durante cinco turnos el daño producido por los ataques especiales.

en.name: Light Screen
en.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.

es.name: Niebla
es.description: Neblina que elimina los cambios de características de todos los Pokémon en combate.

en.name: Haze
en.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

es.name: Reflejo
es.description: Pared de luz que reduce durante cinco turnos el daño producido por los ataques físicos.

en.name: Reflect
en.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.

es.name: Foco Energía
es.description: Concentra energía para aumentar las posibilidades de un golpe crítico.

en.name: Focus Energy
en.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Venganza
es.description: Espera dos turnos para atacar con el doble de potencia del daño recibido.

en.name: Bide
en.description: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

es.name: Metrónomo
es.description: El usuario mueve un dedo y estimula su cerebro para usar al azar casi cualquier movimiento.

en.name: Metronome
en.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

es.name: Espejo
es.description: Contraataca con el mismo movimiento empleado por el objetivo.

en.name: Mirror Move
en.description: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move.

es.name: Autodestrucción
es.description: El atacante explota y hiere a todos a su alrededor. El usuario se debilita de inmediato.

en.name: Self-Destruct
en.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

es.name: Bomba Huevo
es.description: Arroja un huevo al objetivo con gran fuerza.

en.name: Egg Bomb
en.description: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

es.name: Lengüetazo
es.description: Una lengua ataca al objetivo. Puede causar parálisis.

en.name: Lick
en.description: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Polución
es.description: El objetivo es atacado con gases tóxicos que pueden llegar a envenenar.

en.name: Smog
en.description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.

es.name: Residuos
es.description: Arroja residuos al objetivo. Puede llegar a envenenar.

en.name: Sludge
en.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

es.name: Hueso Palo
es.description: Aporrea con un hueso. Puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Bone Club
en.description: The user clubs the target with a bone. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Llamarada
es.description: Llama intensa que chamusca y puede causar quemaduras.

en.name: Fire Blast
en.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

es.name: Cascada
es.description: Embiste con un gran impulso que puede hacer retroceder. También sirve para remontar cascadas.

en.name: Waterfall
en.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. This can also be used to climb a waterfall.

es.name: Tenaza
es.description: Atrapa y atenaza con fuerza durante cuatro o cinco turnos.

en.name: Clamp
en.description: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.

es.name: Meteoros
es.description: Lanza rayos en forma de estrella que no fallan nunca.

en.name: Swift
en.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

es.name: Cabezazo
es.description: Primer turno: se prepara y sube la Defensa del usuario. Segundo turno: da el cabezazo.

en.name: Skull Bash
en.description: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

es.name: Clavo Cañón
es.description: Lanza finas púas que hieren de dos a cinco veces.

en.name: Spike Cannon
en.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

es.name: Restricción
es.description: Constriñe para herir y puede bajar la Velocidad.

en.name: Constrict
en.description: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

es.name: Amnesia
es.description: El usuario olvida sus preocupaciones y aumenta mucho la Defensa Especial.

en.name: Amnesia
en.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

es.name: Kinético
es.description: Dobla una cuchara para distraer al objetivo y bajar su nivel de Precisión.

en.name: Kinesis
en.description: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

es.name: Ovocuración
es.description: Restaura la mitad de los PS máximos del usuario. Fuera de combate se usa para transferir parte de sus PS a un aliado.

en.name: Soft-Boiled
en.description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

es.name: Patada Salto Alta
es.description: Salta muy alto y lanza una patada. Si falla, dañará al usuario.

en.name: High Jump Kick
en.description: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

es.name: Deslumbrar
es.description: Intimida y asusta al objetivo con la mirada para dejarlo paralizado.

en.name: Glare
en.description: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

es.name: Comesueños
es.description: Restaura al usuario la mitad del daño causado a un objetivo dormido.

en.name: Dream Eater
en.description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal its own HP.

es.name: Gas Venenoso
es.description: Lanza una nube de gas tóxico a los rivales. Produce envenenamiento.

en.name: Poison Gas
en.description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. This may also poison those hit.

es.name: Bombardeo
es.description: Arroja esferas al objetivo entre dos y cinco veces seguidas.

en.name: Barrage
en.description: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.

es.name: Chupavidas
es.description: Restaura al usuario la mitad del daño causado al objetivo.

en.name: Leech Life
en.description: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

es.name: Beso Amoroso
es.description: Con una cara que asusta, da un beso al objetivo y lo adormece.

en.name: Lovely Kiss
en.description: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

es.name: Ataque Aéreo
es.description: Ataque en dos turnos que suele ser crítico. Puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Sky Attack
en.description: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Transformación
es.description: El usuario se transforma en una copia del objetivo, con los mismos movimientos.

en.name: Transform
en.description: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

es.name: Burbuja
es.description: Lanza burbujas a los contrincantes y puede reducir su Velocidad.

en.name: Bubble
en.description: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their Speed stats.

es.name: Puño Mareo
es.description: Rítmicos puñetazos que pueden causar confusión.

en.name: Dizzy Punch
en.description: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches. This may also leave the target confused.

es.name: Espora
es.description: Esparce esporas que inducen al sueño.

en.name: Spore
en.description: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

es.name: Destello
es.description: Luz cegadora que baja la Precisión del objetivo.

en.name: Flash
en.description: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy.

es.name: Psicoonda
es.description: Ataque con una onda de energía de intensidad variable.

en.name: Psywave
en.description: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

es.name: Salpicadura
es.description: No tiene ningún efecto. Solo salpica.

en.name: Splash
en.description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

es.name: Armadura Ácida
es.description: Transforma la estructura celular para hacerse líquido y aumenta mucho la Defensa.

en.name: Acid Armor
en.description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

es.name: Martillazo
es.description: Golpea con fuerza con una pinza enorme. Suele ser crítico.

en.name: Crabhammer
en.description: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Explosión
es.description: El atacante causa una grandísima explosión y hiere a todos a su alrededor. El usuario se debilita de inmediato.

en.name: Explosion
en.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

es.name: Golpes Furia
es.description: Araña rápidamente de dos a cinco veces.

en.name: Fury Swipes
en.description: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes quickly two to five times in a row.

es.name: Huesomerang
es.description: Lanza un hueso a modo de bumerán que golpea dos veces.

en.name: Bonemerang
en.description: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the target twice, coming and going.

es.name: Descanso
es.description: Restaura todos los PS y cura todos los problemas de estado del usuario. Duerme los dos próximos turnos.

en.name: Rest
en.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

es.name: Avalancha
es.description: Lanza grandes pedruscos. Puede hacer retroceder a los rivales.

en.name: Rock Slide
en.description: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

es.name: Hipercolmillo
es.description: Ataque con finos colmillos. Puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Hyper Fang
en.description: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Afilar
es.description: El perfil del usuario se hace más afilado y su Ataque mejora.

en.name: Sharpen
en.description: The user lowers its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.

es.name: Conversión
es.description: Cambia el tipo del usuario por el del primero de sus movimientos.

en.name: Conversion
en.description: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.

es.name: Triataque
es.description: Ataque triple que puede paralizar, quemar o congelar al objetivo.

en.name: Tri Attack
en.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Superdiente
es.description: Finos colmillos que reducen a la mitad los PS del objetivo.

en.name: Super Fang
en.description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

es.name: Cuchillada
es.description: Ataca con cuchillas o con pinzas. Suele dar un golpe crítico.

en.name: Slash
en.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Sustituto
es.description: Utiliza parte de los PS propios para crear un sustituto que actúa como señuelo.

en.name: Substitute
en.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

es.name: Forcejeo
es.description: Solo se usa como último recurso al acabarse los PP. Hiere un poco al agresor.

en.name: Struggle
en.description: An attack that is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. This also damages the user a little.

es.name: Esquema
es.description: Aprende de forma permanente el último movimiento utilizado por el objetivo. Es de un solo uso.

en.name: Sketch
en.description: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.

es.name: Triple Patada
es.description: Patea hasta tres veces seguidas y cada vez más fuerte.

en.name: Triple Kick
en.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

es.name: Ladrón
es.description: Ataca y le quita al objetivo el objeto que lleve. Si el agresor lleva un objeto, no robará el del objetivo.

en.name: Thief
en.description: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it already holds an item.

es.name: Telaraña
es.description: Enreda al objetivo para evitar que abandone la batalla.

en.name: Spider Web
en.description: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.

es.name: Telépata
es.description: El usuario adivina los movimientos del objetivo para hacer que su siguiente ataque no falle.

en.name: Mind Reader
en.description: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.

es.name: Pesadilla
es.description: El objetivo dormido sufre una pesadilla que le hace perder PS en cada turno.

en.name: Nightmare
en.description: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.

es.name: Rueda Fuego
es.description: Ataca envuelto en fuego. Puede causar quemaduras.

en.name: Flame Wheel
en.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

es.name: Ronquido
es.description: Fuerte ronquido que solo puede usarse dormido. Puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Snore
en.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Maldición
es.description: Un movimiento que tiene efectos distintos si el usuario es de tipo Fantasma o no.

en.name: Curse
en.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

es.name: Azote
es.description: Ataque frenético. Cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario, más daño producirá.

en.name: Flail
en.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power.

es.name: Conversión 2
es.description: El usuario cambia de tipo para hacerse resistente al último tipo de movimiento usado por el objetivo.

en.name: Conversion 2
en.description: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.

es.name: Aerochorro
es.description: Lanza un chorro de aire que suele dar un golpe crítico.

en.name: Aeroblast
en.description: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Esporagodón
es.description: Adhiere esporas a los rivales para reducir mucho su Velocidad.

en.name: Cotton Spore
en.description: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the opposing Pokémon, which harshly lowers their Speed stats.

es.name: Inversión
es.description: Ataque desesperado que causa más daño cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario.

en.name: Reversal
en.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

es.name: Rencor
es.description: Da rienda suelta a su rencor para reducir cuatro PP del último movimiento usado por el objetivo.

en.name: Spite
en.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

es.name: Nieve Polvo
es.description: Lanza nieve que puede llegar a congelar.

en.name: Powder Snow
en.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also freeze the opposing Pokémon.

es.name: Protección
es.description: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.

en.name: Protect
en.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

es.name: Ultrapuño
es.description: Puñetazo que se da rápido para golpear primero.

en.name: Mach Punch
en.description: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

es.name: Cara Susto
es.description: Asusta al objetivo para reducir mucho su Velocidad.

en.name: Scary Face
en.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

es.name: Finta
es.description: Engaña al objetivo para acercarse y dar un puñetazo que no falla.

en.name: Feint Attack
en.description: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.

es.name: Beso Dulce
es.description: Da un beso con tal dulzura que causa confusión.

en.name: Sweet Kiss
en.description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

es.name: Tambor
es.description: Reduce la mitad de los PS máximos para mejorar al máximo el Ataque.

en.name: Belly Drum
en.description: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

es.name: Bomba Lodo
es.description: Arroja residuos al objetivo. Puede llegar a envenenar.

en.name: Sludge Bomb
en.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

es.name: Bofetón Lodo
es.description: Echa lodo en la cara para bajar la Precisión.

en.name: Mud-Slap
en.description: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

es.name: Pulpocañón
es.description: Dispara tinta a la cara. Puede bajar la Precisión.

en.name: Octazooka
en.description: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.

es.name: Púas
es.description: Esparce púas en el equipo rival. Las púas hieren a los Pokémon rivales que entran en combate.

en.name: Spikes
en.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

es.name: Electrocañón
es.description: Dispara una descarga eléctrica que causa daño y parálisis.

en.name: Zap Cannon
en.description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

es.name: Profecía
es.description: Permite atacar con cualquier movimiento a objetivos de tipo Fantasma y golpear a Pokémon evasivos.

en.name: Foresight
en.description: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

es.name: Mismo Destino
es.description: Si el usuario se debilita por un ataque rival antes de usar otro movimiento, el Pokémon rival se debilitará también.

en.name: Destiny Bond
en.description: When this move is used, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints.

es.name: Canto Mortal
es.description: Si un Pokémon escucha este canto y no es cambiado por otro en tres turnos, acaba debilitándose.

en.name: Perish Song
en.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

es.name: Viento Hielo
es.description: Ataque con aire helado que baja la Velocidad de los rivales.

en.name: Icy Wind
en.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers the opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

es.name: Detección
es.description: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.

en.name: Detect
en.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

es.name: Ataque Óseo
es.description: Hueso en ristre, aporrea al objetivo de dos a cinco veces.

en.name: Bone Rush
en.description: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

es.name: Fijar Blanco
es.description: Fija el blanco para que el siguiente ataque no falle.

en.name: Lock-On
en.description: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the next attack does not miss the target.

es.name: Enfado
es.description: Ataca de dos a tres turnos y acaba confundiendo al agresor.

en.name: Outrage
en.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

es.name: Tormenta de Arena
es.description: Tormenta de arena que dura cinco turnos y hiere a todos, excepto a los de tipo Roca, Tierra y Acero.

en.name: Sandstorm
en.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

es.name: Gigadrenado
es.description: Un ataque que absorbe nutrientes. Quien lo usa recupera la mitad de los PS del daño que produce.

en.name: Giga Drain
en.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

es.name: Aguante
es.description: Resiste cualquier ataque y deja al menos 1 PS. Puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.

en.name: Endure
en.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

es.name: Encanto
es.description: Engatusa al objetivo y reduce bastante su Ataque.

en.name: Charm
en.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers its Attack stat.

es.name: Rodar
es.description: El atacante rueda contra el objetivo durante cinco turnos, cada vez con mayor fuerza.

en.name: Rollout
en.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes more powerful each time it hits.

es.name: Falso Tortazo
es.description: Ataque moderado que no debilita al objetivo y le deja al menos 1 PS.

en.name: False Swipe
en.description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

es.name: Fanfarronear
es.description: Provoca confusión en el objetivo, pero también sube mucho su Ataque.

en.name: Swagger
en.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

es.name: Batido
es.description: Restaura la mitad de los PS máximos del usuario. Fuera de combate se usa para transferir parte de sus PS a un aliado.

en.name: Milk Drink
en.description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

es.name: Chispa
es.description: Ataque eléctrico que puede llegar a paralizar.

en.name: Spark
en.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Corte Furia
es.description: Ataque con garras o guadaña que crece en intensidad si se usa repetidas veces.

en.name: Fury Cutter
en.description: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.

es.name: Ala de Acero
es.description: Alas macizas que golpean al objetivo y pueden subir la Defensa del usuario.

en.name: Steel Wing
en.description: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

es.name: Mal de Ojo
es.description: Mal de ojo que impide al objetivo huir de la batalla.

en.name: Mean Look
en.description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

es.name: Atracción
es.description: Si el objetivo es del sexo opuesto, se enamorará y bajará la posibilidad de que ataque.

en.name: Attract
en.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

es.name: Sonámbulo
es.description: Mientras duerme, usa uno de sus movimientos elegido al azar.

en.name: Sleep Talk
en.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

es.name: Cascabel Cura
es.description: Tañido que cura los problemas de estado de todos los Pokémon del equipo.

en.name: Heal Bell
en.description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status conditions of all the party Pokémon.

es.name: Retribución
es.description: Cuanto mayor sea la amistad con el Entrenador, más poderoso será este ataque.

en.name: Return
en.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

es.name: Presente
es.description: Quien lo usa ataca al objetivo dándole un regalo con bomba trampa. Sin embargo, a veces restaura sus PS.

en.name: Present
en.description: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.

es.name: Frustración
es.description: Cuanto menor sea la amistad con el Entrenador, más poderoso será este ataque.

en.name: Frustration
en.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

es.name: Velo Sagrado
es.description: Un escudo que protege de problemas de estado, como el sueño o la parálisis, durante cinco turnos.

en.name: Safeguard
en.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

es.name: Divide Dolor
es.description: Suma los PS del usuario a los del objetivo y los reparte a partes iguales.

en.name: Pain Split
en.description: The user adds its HP to the target’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

es.name: Fuego Sagrado
es.description: Fuego místico de gran intensidad que puede causar quemaduras.

en.name: Sacred Fire
en.description: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This may also leave the target with a burn.

es.name: Magnitud
es.description: Sacudida sísmica de intensidad variable que afecta a todos los Pokémon a su alrededor.

en.name: Magnitude
en.description: The user attacks everything around it with a ground-shaking quake. Its power varies.

es.name: Puño Dinámico
es.description: Puñetazo con toda la fuerza concentrada. Causa confusión si atina.

en.name: Dynamic Punch
en.description: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. This confuses the target if it hits.

es.name: Megacuerno
es.description: Violenta embestida con cuernos imponentes.

en.name: Megahorn
en.description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

es.name: Dragoaliento
es.description: Poderosa ráfaga de aliento que golpea al objetivo y puede paralizarlo.

en.name: Dragon Breath
en.description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Relevo
es.description: Cambia el puesto con un compañero y le pasa los cambios de características.

en.name: Baton Pass
en.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

es.name: Otra Vez
es.description: El objetivo repite su último movimiento durante tres turnos.

en.name: Encore
en.description: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.

es.name: Persecución
es.description: Hace el doble de daño al objetivo que pide el relevo.

en.name: Pursuit
en.description: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.

es.name: Giro Rápido
es.description: Ataque giratorio que puede eliminar movimientos como Atadura, Constricción, Drenadoras y Púas.

en.name: Rapid Spin
en.description: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.

es.name: Dulce Aroma
es.description: Un dulce aroma engatusa al objetivo, por lo que se reduce mucho su Evasión. En la hierba alta sirve para atraer a Pokémon salvajes.

en.name: Sweet Scent
en.description: A sweet scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon’s evasiveness. This also lures wild Pokémon if used in places such as tall grass.

es.name: Cola Férrea
es.description: Ataca con una cola férrea y puede bajar la Defensa del objetivo.

en.name: Iron Tail
en.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

es.name: Garra Metal
es.description: Ataque con garras de acero que puede aumentar el Ataque del usuario.

en.name: Metal Claw
en.description: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

es.name: Llave Vital
es.description: El usuario ataca el último, pero no falla.

en.name: Vital Throw
en.description: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.

es.name: Sol Matinal
es.description: Restaura PS del usuario. La cantidad varía según el tiempo que haga.

en.name: Morning Sun
en.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

es.name: Fotosíntesis
es.description: Restaura PS del usuario. La cantidad varía según el tiempo que haga.

en.name: Synthesis
en.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

es.name: Luz Lunar
es.description: Restaura PS del usuario. La cantidad varía según el tiempo que haga.

en.name: Moonlight
en.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

es.name: Poder Oculto
es.description: Movimiento cuyo tipo varía en función del Pokémon que lo usa.

en.name: Hidden Power
en.description: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.

es.name: Tajo Cruzado
es.description: Corte doble que suele propinar un golpe crítico.

en.name: Cross Chop
en.description: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Ciclón
es.description: Crea un violento tornado para hacer trizas al enemigo. Puede hacerlo retroceder.

en.name: Twister
en.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.

es.name: Danza Lluvia
es.description: Genera una fuerte lluvia que refuerza los movimientos de tipo Agua durante cinco turnos.

en.name: Rain Dance
en.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

es.name: Día Soleado
es.description: Quien lo usa intensifica el efecto del sol durante cinco turnos, lo que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fuego.

en.name: Sunny Day
en.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

es.name: Triturar
es.description: Tritura con afilados colmillos y puede bajar la Defensa del objetivo.

en.name: Crunch
en.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

es.name: Manto Espejo
es.description: Responde a un ataque especial ocasionando el doble del daño recibido.

en.name: Mirror Coat
en.description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

es.name: Autosugestión
es.description: Quien lo usa se hipnotiza y copia cualquier cambio que haya en las características de su objetivo.

en.name: Psych Up
en.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

es.name: Velocidad Extrema
es.description: Ataque muy rápido que siempre se realiza el primero.

en.name: Extreme Speed
en.description: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

es.name: Poder Pasado
es.description: Ataque prehistórico que puede subir todas las características.

en.name: Ancient Power
en.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

es.name: Bola Sombra
es.description: Lanza una bola oscura que puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.

en.name: Shadow Ball
en.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

es.name: Premonición
es.description: Concentra energía psíquica para golpear al objetivo dos turnos después.

en.name: Future Sight
en.description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

es.name: Golpe Roca
es.description: Ataque con los puños. Puede bajar la Defensa del objetivo. Puede romper rocas fuera del combate.

en.name: Rock Smash
en.description: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat. This move can also shatter rocks in the field.

es.name: Torbellino
es.description: Una tromba de agua atrapa al objetivo durante cuatro o cinco turnos.

en.name: Whirlpool
en.description: The user traps the target in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

es.name: Paliza
es.description: Ataque de todo el equipo Pokémon. Cuantos más haya, más veces se atacará.

en.name: Beat Up
en.description: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

es.name: Sorpresa
es.description: Ataca primero y, además, hace retroceder al objetivo. Solo sirve en el primer turno.

en.name: Fake Out
en.description: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.

es.name: Alboroto
es.description: Ataca de forma alborotada durante tres turnos. Mantiene despiertos a todos.

en.name: Uproar
en.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no one can fall asleep.

es.name: Reserva
es.description: Acumula energía y sube la Defensa y la Defensa Especial. Puede utilizarse hasta tres veces.

en.name: Stockpile
en.description: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def stats. The move can be used three times.

es.name: Escupir
es.description: Libera de una vez la energía acumulada con Reserva.

en.name: Spit Up
en.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move’s power.

es.name: Tragar
es.description: Absorbe la energía acumulada con Reserva y restaura PS.

en.name: Swallow
en.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP. Storing more power heals more HP.

es.name: Onda Ígnea
es.description: Provoca un viento abrasador que puede quemar al objetivo.

en.name: Heat Wave
en.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on the opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

es.name: Granizo
es.description: Tormenta de granizo que dura cinco turnos. Hiere a todos, excepto a los de tipo Hielo.

en.name: Hail
en.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

es.name: Tormento
es.description: Atormenta y enfurece al objetivo, que no puede usar dos veces seguidas el mismo movimiento.

en.name: Torment
en.description: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

es.name: Camelo
es.description: Halaga al objetivo y lo confunde, pero también sube su Ataque Especial.

en.name: Flatter
en.description: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also raises the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

es.name: Fuego Fatuo
es.description: Siniestra llama morada que produce quemaduras.

en.name: Will-O-Wisp
en.description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

es.name: Legado
es.description: El usuario se debilita, pero baja mucho tanto el Ataque como el Ataque Especial del objetivo.

en.name: Memento
en.description: The user faints when using this move. In return, this harshly lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

es.name: Fachada
es.description: Ataca con el doble de potencia si el usuario está quemado, paralizado o envenenado.

en.name: Facade
en.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or has paralysis.

es.name: Puño Certero
es.description: Se concentra para dar un puñetazo. Falla si se sufre un golpe antes de su uso.

en.name: Focus Punch
en.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before it is used.

es.name: Estímulo
es.description: Hace el doble de daño a objetivos paralizados, pero también cura la parálisis.

en.name: Smelling Salts
en.description: This attack inflicts double damage on a target with paralysis. This also cures the target’s paralysis, however.

es.name: Señuelo
es.description: Llama la atención para concentrar todos los ataques de todos los del equipo rival hacia sí mismo.

en.name: Follow Me
en.description: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

es.name: Adaptación
es.description: Usa el poder de la naturaleza para atacar. Su efecto varía según el entorno de combate.

en.name: Nature Power
en.description: An attack that makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

es.name: Carga
es.description: Recarga energía para potenciar el siguiente movimiento de tipo Eléctrico. También sube la Defensa Especial.

en.name: Charge
en.description: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses on the next turn. This also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

es.name: Mofa
es.description: Enfurece al objetivo para que solo use movimientos de ataque durante tres turnos.

en.name: Taunt
en.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

es.name: Refuerzo
es.description: El usuario ayuda a un aliado reforzando la potencia de su ataque.

en.name: Helping Hand
en.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally’s attack.

es.name: Truco
es.description: Engaña al objetivo desprevenido e intercambia objetos.

en.name: Trick
en.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

es.name: Imitación
es.description: Imita al objetivo por completo y copia su habilidad.

en.name: Role Play
en.description: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target’s natural Ability.

es.name: Deseo
es.description: Restaura la mitad de los PS máximos en el siguiente turno.

en.name: Wish
en.description: One turn after this move is used, the target’s HP is restored by half the user’s max HP.

es.name: Ayuda
es.description: Usa un movimiento de un miembro del equipo elegido al azar.

en.name: Assist
en.description: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.

es.name: Arraigo
es.description: Echa raíces para recuperar PS en cada turno, pero impide el relevo.

en.name: Ingrain
en.description: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can’t switch out.

es.name: Fuerza Bruta
es.description: Ataque de gran potencia, pero que reduce el Ataque y la Defensa del agresor.

en.name: Superpower
en.description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

es.name: Capa Mágica
es.description: Barrera capaz de devolver al agresor movimientos como Drenadoras y otros que alteran el estado o las características.

en.name: Magic Coat
en.description: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

es.name: Reciclaje
es.description: Recicla y así recupera un objeto equipado de un solo uso que ya haya sido empleado durante el combate.

en.name: Recycle
en.description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

es.name: Desquite
es.description: Ataque que produce el doble de daño si el usuario es herido en el mismo turno.

en.name: Revenge
en.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

es.name: Demolición
es.description: Potente ataque que también es capaz de destruir barreras como Pantalla de Luz y Reflejo.

en.name: Brick Break
en.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

es.name: Bostezo
es.description: Gran bostezo que induce al sueño al objetivo en el siguiente turno.

en.name: Yawn
en.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

es.name: Desarme
es.description: Impide al objetivo usar el objeto que lleva durante el combate. La potencia del movimiento se multiplica si el objetivo lleva un objeto.

en.name: Knock Off
en.description: The user slaps down the target’s held item, and that item can’t be used in that battle. The move does more damage if the target has a held item.

es.name: Esfuerzo
es.description: Reduce los PS del objetivo para que igualen a los del atacante.

en.name: Endeavor
en.description: An attack move that cuts down the target’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

es.name: Estallido
es.description: Furia explosiva. Cuanto menor sea el número de PS del usuario, menos daño hará el ataque.

en.name: Eruption
en.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user’s HP, the lower the move’s power.

es.name: Intercambio
es.description: Usa el poder psíquico para intercambiar habilidades con el objetivo.

en.name: Skill Swap
en.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

es.name: Sellar
es.description: Impide a los contrincantes usar ataques conocidos por el usuario durante el combate.

en.name: Imprison
en.description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

es.name: Alivio
es.description: Descansa para curar parálisis, envenenamiento o quemaduras.

en.name: Refresh
en.description: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

es.name: Rabia
es.description: Si el usuario se debilita al recibir un ataque, todos los PP de este último ataque serán eliminados.

en.name: Grudge
en.description: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.

es.name: Robo
es.description: Roba el efecto de los movimientos de curación o de cambio de características que se usen.

en.name: Snatch
en.description: The user steals the effects of any attempts to use a healing or stat-changing move.

es.name: Daño Secreto
es.description: Ataque con poder secreto cuyos efectos secundarios varían según el entorno de combate.

en.name: Secret Power
en.description: The user attacks the target with a secret power. Its additional effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

es.name: Buceo
es.description: El usuario se sumerge en el primer turno y ataca en el segundo.

en.name: Dive
en.description: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.

es.name: Empujón
es.description: Empujones directos que golpean de dos a cinco veces seguidas.

en.name: Arm Thrust
en.description: The user lets loose a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

es.name: Camuflaje
es.description: Modifica el tipo del Pokémon según el terreno de combate donde esté.

en.name: Camouflage
en.description: The user’s type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water’s edge, in grass, or in a cave.

es.name: Luminicola
es.description: Se concentra en una ráfaga de luz que sube muchísimo el Ataque Especial.

en.name: Tail Glow
en.description: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

es.name: Resplandor
es.description: Fogonazo de luz que puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.

en.name: Luster Purge
en.description: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

es.name: Bola Neblina
es.description: Banco de niebla que puede bajar el Ataque Especial del objetivo.

en.name: Mist Ball
en.description: A mist-like flurry of down envelops and damages the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

es.name: Danza Pluma
es.description: Envuelve al objetivo con un manto de plumas para reducir mucho su Ataque.

en.name: Feather Dance
en.description: The user covers the target’s body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

es.name: Danza Caos
es.description: Danza histérica que confunde a los Pokémon que están alrededor del usuario.

en.name: Teeter Dance
en.description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

es.name: Patada Ígnea
es.description: Patada que suele ser un golpe crítico y puede causar quemaduras.

en.name: Blaze Kick
en.description: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. This may also leave the target with a burn.

es.name: Chapoteo Lodo
es.description: El usuario esparce lodo a su alrededor, lo que debilita los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico durante cinco turnos.

en.name: Mud Sport
en.description: The user covers itself with mud. This weakens Electric-type moves for five turns.

es.name: Bola Hielo
es.description: El atacante rueda contra el objetivo durante cinco turnos, cada vez con mayor fuerza.

en.name: Ice Ball
en.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

es.name: Brazo Pincho
es.description: Pega con brazos de pinchos y puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Needle Arm
en.description: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Relajo
es.description: El usuario se relaja y restaura la mitad de sus PS máximos.

en.name: Slack Off
en.description: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

es.name: Vozarrón
es.description: Grito desgarrador que inflige daño al objetivo.

en.name: Hyper Voice
en.description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

es.name: Colmillo Veneno
es.description: Colmillos tóxicos que pueden envenenar gravemente al objetivo.

en.name: Poison Fang
en.description: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

es.name: Garra Brutal
es.description: Hace trizas al objetivo con garras afiladas y puede bajar su Defensa.

en.name: Crush Claw
en.description: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

es.name: Anillo Ígneo
es.description: Explosión de fuego. El atacante debe descansar el siguiente turno.

en.name: Blast Burn
en.description: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can’t move on the next turn.

es.name: Hidrocañón
es.description: Disparo de agua. El atacante debe descansar el siguiente turno.

en.name: Hydro Cannon
en.description: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can’t move on the next turn.

es.name: Puño Meteoro
es.description: Puñetazo que impacta como un meteorito y puede subir el Ataque del agresor.

en.name: Meteor Mash
en.description: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

es.name: Impresionar
es.description: Impresiona tanto que puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Astonish
en.description: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Meteorobola
es.description: El tipo y fuerza del ataque varían según el tiempo que haga.

en.name: Weather Ball
en.description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

es.name: Aromaterapia
es.description: Cura todos los problemas de estado del equipo con un suave aroma.

en.name: Aromatherapy
en.description: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status conditions affecting the user’s party.

es.name: Llanto Falso
es.description: Lágrimas de cocodrilo que bajan mucho la Defensa Especial del objetivo.

en.name: Fake Tears
en.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

es.name: Aire Afilado
es.description: Viento cortante que azota. Suele ser un golpe crítico.

en.name: Air Cutter
en.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the opposing Pokémon. Critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Sofoco
es.description: Ataque en toda regla que baja mucho el Ataque Especial de quien lo usa.

en.name: Overheat
en.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

es.name: Rastreo
es.description: Permite atacar con cualquier movimiento a objetivos de tipo Fantasma y golpear a Pokémon evasivos.

en.name: Odor Sleuth
en.description: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

es.name: Tumba Rocas
es.description: Tira rocas que detienen al objetivo y bajan su Velocidad.

en.name: Rock Tomb
en.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

es.name: Viento Plata
es.description: Fuerte viento con polvo de escamas. Puede subir todas las características de quien lo usa.

en.name: Silver Wind
en.description: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. This may also raise all the user’s stats.

es.name: Eco Metálico
es.description: Horrible chirrido metálico que baja mucho la Defensa Especial del objetivo.

en.name: Metal Sound
en.description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

es.name: Silbato
es.description: Agradable melodía que adormece al objetivo.

en.name: Grass Whistle
en.description: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the target into a deep sleep.

es.name: Cosquillas
es.description: Hace reír al objetivo para bajar su Ataque y Defensa.

en.name: Tickle
en.description: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

es.name: Masa Cósmica
es.description: Sube la Defensa y la Defensa Especial propias con energía mística.

en.name: Cosmic Power
en.description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

es.name: Salpicar
es.description: Chorro de agua. Cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario, menos dañino será.

en.name: Water Spout
en.description: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user’s HP, the lower the move’s power.

es.name: Rayo Señal
es.description: Ataca con un rayo de luz siniestro. Puede confundir al objetivo.

en.name: Signal Beam
en.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. This may also confuse the target.

es.name: Puño Sombra
es.description: Puñetazo ineludible procedente de las sombras.

en.name: Shadow Punch
en.description: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.

es.name: Paranormal
es.description: Energía muy extraña que puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

en.name: Extrasensory
en.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.

es.name: Gancho Alto
es.description: Gancho ascendente de gran ímpetu.

en.name: Sky Uppercut
en.description: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

es.name: Bucle Arena
es.description: Enreda al objetivo en un remolino de arena de cuatro a cinco turnos.

en.name: Sand Tomb
en.description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

es.name: Frío Polar
es.description: Ataque de frío polar que debilita al objetivo si le alcanza.

en.name: Sheer Cold
en.description: The target is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

es.name: Agua Lodosa
es.description: Ataque con agua lodosa que puede bajar la Precisión del equipo rival.

en.name: Muddy Water
en.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

es.name: Semilladora
es.description: Dispara rápido de dos a cinco ráfagas de semillas de manera consecutiva.

en.name: Bullet Seed
en.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target two to five times in a row.

es.name: Golpe Aéreo
es.description: El usuario lanza un ataque muy rápido e ineludible.

en.name: Aerial Ace
en.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

es.name: Carámbano
es.description: Ataca lanzando de dos a cinco ráfagas consecutivas de carámbanos.

en.name: Icicle Spear
en.description: The user launches sharp icicles at the target two to five times in a row.

es.name: Defensa Férrea
es.description: Fortalece el cuerpo como si fuera de hierro y sube mucho la Defensa.

en.name: Iron Defense
en.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

es.name: Bloqueo
es.description: Le corta el paso al objetivo para que no pueda escapar.

en.name: Block
en.description: The user blocks the target’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

es.name: Aullido
es.description: Aullido que sube el ánimo y aumenta el Ataque.

en.name: Howl
en.description: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, which raises its Attack stat.

es.name: Garra Dragón
es.description: Araña al objetivo con garras afiladas.

en.name: Dragon Claw
en.description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

es.name: Planta Feroz
es.description: Golpea con una enorme planta. Quien lo usa no puede moverse en el siguiente turno.

en.name: Frenzy Plant
en.description: The user slams the target with an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.

es.name: Corpulencia
es.description: Robustece el cuerpo para subir el Ataque y la Defensa.

en.name: Bulk Up
en.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

es.name: Bote
es.description: Primer turno: bota. Segundo turno: golpea. Puede paralizar.

en.name: Bounce
en.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Disparo Lodo
es.description: El usuario lanza lodo al objetivo y reduce su Velocidad.

en.name: Mud Shot
en.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

es.name: Cola Veneno
es.description: Puede envenenar y dar un golpe crítico.

en.name: Poison Tail
en.description: The user hits the target with its tail. This may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

es.name: Antojo
es.description: Se acerca con ternura al objetivo, pero le ataca y le roba el objeto que lleve.

en.name: Covet
en.description: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target’s held item.

es.name: Placaje Eléctrico
es.description: Quien lo usa electrifica su cuerpo para luego atacar. Se hiere mucho a sí mismo, pero puede paralizar al objetivo.

en.name: Volt Tackle
en.description: The user electrifies itself, then charges. This also damages the user quite a lot. This may leave the target with paralysis.

es.name: Hoja Mágica
es.description: Esparce extrañas hojas que persiguen al objetivo. No se puede esquivar.

en.name: Magical Leaf
en.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

es.name: Hidrochorro
es.description: El usuario se empapa en agua, lo que debilita los movimientos de tipo Fuego durante cinco turnos.

en.name: Water Sport
en.description: The user soaks itself with water. This weakens Fire-type moves for five turns.

es.name: Paz Mental
es.description: Aumenta la concentración y calma el espíritu para subir el Ataque Especial y la Defensa Especial.

en.name: Calm Mind
en.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
